versions.content: Reporting successful clearing of dtc to IdsM In case a diagnostic service ClearDiagnosticInformation is received, which results in a positive response, the Dcm shall report a security event SEV_UDS_CLEAR_DTC_SUCCESSFUL to IdsM (see [11] and table [SWS_Dcm_01731]) with the context data given in [SWS_Dcm_01731].
